FICTIONAL TEST RECORD — not a real transaction
Signed amendment to order H-260828

1. Agreement and date
Harper Studio and Elm Supply signed this amendment on September 3, 2026.
It adds four chairs to the original twenty-four, making twenty-eight chairs.

2. Price and delivery changes
The unit price remains $50. Flat freight remains $90 for the whole order,
not $90 per delivery. No rush charge is authorized by this amendment.
The amended total is 28 x $50 + $90 = $1,490.
Twenty chairs are due September 10, 2026. The remaining eight chairs are
due September 17, 2026. This replaces the original single delivery deadline.

3. Unchanged payment conditions
The original $400 deposit requirement and payment conditions remain unchanged:
the balance is payable after BOTH complete delivery and customer acceptance
of the invoice. Signing this amendment does not acknowledge delivery,
payment, or acceptance of any invoice.
